preconditions.description: The number of rows in the first map must be between 1 and 2000.
The number of columns in the first map must be between 1 and 200.
The number of columns in the first map must not exceed the number of rows.

postconditions.description: The row index i of the M × M section in the first map must be within the valid range.
The column index j of the M × M section in the second map must be within the valid range.

postconditions.expression: all(first_map[i + k][j:j + M] == second_map[k][j:j + M] for k in range(M))
postconditions.description: The M × M section starting at (i, j) in the first map must match the M × M section starting at (0, j) in the second map.
